'''Magan''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who lived on [[Hijado]]. Like other [[Hijadoan]]s, Magan was long-lived and was far more older than she appeared. When [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Parlay Thorp]] questioned the apparent lack of elderly people among the Hijadoans, [[Noneen]] told her that Magan was 101 years old.<ref name="Millennium Falcon" />
